prizes.description: Won the most games above what the scores deserved

weeks.label: Top Gun
weeks.rule: Most points scored this week.

weeks.label: Air Raid
weeks.rule: Most combined points from started receivers and tight ends.

weeks.label: Bend Don’t Break
weeks.rule: Highest-scoring started defence.

weeks.label: No Weak Links
weeks.rule: Smallest gap between your best and worst starter. Depth, not a hero. Kickers and defences do not count.

weeks.label: Second Fiddle
weeks.rule: Highest-scoring *second*-best starter. Your stud does not count.

weeks.label: Photo Finish
weeks.rule: Won by the smallest margin. Ugly counts.

weeks.label: Everybody Eats
weeks.rule: Most started players scoring 15 or more points. Depth across the whole lineup, not one hero.

weeks.label: Paydirt
weeks.rule: Most touchdowns scored by your starters (rushing, receiving and return TDs). Ties go to the lower team score.

weeks.label: Price Is Right
weeks.rule: Closest to 100 points without going over. Bust and you are out.

weeks.label: Toe The Line
weeks.rule: Highest-scoring started kicker. The one week it pays to care.

weeks.label: So Close
weeks.rule: Lost by the smallest margin. Only losing teams are eligible.

weeks.label: Stole One
weeks.rule: Lowest score that still won.

weeks.label: Sitting On A Gold Mine
weeks.rule: Most points left on the bench. A prize for the worst decision of the week.
